import sys

def YearUniversityAdmission(n, array):
    total = sum(array)
    return total // n

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    years = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    result = YearUniversityAdmission(n, years)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
